verdicts.reason: A breaks the brand: the dark logo now sits on navy and almost disappears. The white header panel has moved to the top-right with the CTA inside it, apart from the logo. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, so the reading order is jumbled, and the divider is gone. B keeps the original's hierarchy and the logo intact, but it is just a shrunk portrait copy placed in the middle of the landscape canvas. Its body copy and 'Ships late June' are too small to read, the logo is tiny, and wide empty margins on both sides plus dead space below make it look unadapted. Even so, B is the less broken of the two.
